nova_burst.name: Nova Burst
nova_burst.desc: Ring blast around you: radius {radius} m, x{damage} gun damage, knocks enemies back.

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.desc: Lightning hits your target and jumps to {jumps} more enemies, x{damage} gun damage, shocked enemies take +{vuln}% damage for 4 s.

gravity_well.name: Gravity Well
gravity_well.desc: Throw an orb: pulls enemies within {radius} m for {seconds} s, then detonates for x{damage} gun damage.

frost_pulse.name: Frost Pulse
frost_pulse.desc: Freezes enemies within {radius} m for {seconds} s (bosses are only slowed). Frozen enemies take +{vuln}% damage.

swarm_drones.name: Swarm Drones
swarm_drones.desc: {drones} drones shoot the nearest enemies for {seconds} s, each shot {damage} of your gun damage.

rally_cry.name: Rally Cry
rally_cry.desc: For {seconds} s you deal +{damage}% damage and heal {regen}% max health per second.

fire_trail_dash.name: Fire Trail Dash
fire_trail_dash.desc: Dash {distance} m ahead. The path burns for {seconds} s: enemies on it catch fire for x{burn} gun damage a second.

orbital_strike.name: Orbital Strike
orbital_strike.desc: Mark the spot you aim at. {delay} s later a beam hits {radius} m round it for x{damage} gun damage.

bullet_storm.name: Bullet Storm
bullet_storm.desc: For {seconds} s the gun fires x{rate} as fast and uses no ammo.

decoy_hologram.name: Decoy Hologram
decoy_hologram.desc: A hologram of you at the crosshair draws every enemy within {reach} m for {seconds} s, then bursts {radius} m for x{damage} gun damage.

shockwave_slam.name: Shockwave Slam
shockwave_slam.desc: Leap up and slam down: {radius} m, x{damage} gun damage, stuns {stun} s.

vacuum_pulse.name: Vacuum Pulse
vacuum_pulse.desc: A {length} m cone drags enemies to you for x{damage} gun damage.

time_bubble.name: Time Bubble
time_bubble.desc: A {radius} m bubble round you for {seconds} s: enemies inside move at {speed}% speed.

rocket_barrage.name: Rocket Barrage
rocket_barrage.desc: {rockets} homing rockets, each at a different enemy within {range} m, x{damage} gun damage in {radius} m.

plague_cloud.name: Plague Cloud
plague_cloud.desc: A {radius} m toxic cloud at the crosshair for {seconds} s: x{damage} gun damage a second and {slow}% slower inside.

blood_rush.name: Blood Rush
blood_rush.desc: Heal {heal}% at once; for {seconds} s move {speed}% faster and heal {leech}% of the damage you deal.

mirror_clone.name: Mirror Clone
mirror_clone.desc: A clone beside you shoots for {seconds} s at {damage}% of your gun damage.

meteor_shower.name: Meteor Shower
meteor_shower.desc: {meteors} meteors fall across {area} m at the crosshair over {seconds} s, each x{damage} gun damage in {radius} m.

sticky_mines.name: Sticky Mines
sticky_mines.desc: Scatter {mines} mines round the crosshair. Each bursts {radius} m for x{damage} gun damage when an enemy comes near (they last {seconds} s).

sentry_turret.name: Sentry Turret
sentry_turret.desc: Drop a turret that shoots enemies within {range} m for {seconds} s, each shot {damage}% of your gun damage.

thunder_totem.name: Thunder Totem
thunder_totem.desc: Plant a totem at the crosshair for {seconds} s: every {every} s it strikes {targets} enemies within {radius} m for x{damage} gun damage.

phase_step.name: Phase Step
phase_step.desc: Blink {distance} m ahead. Your next {shots} shots within {seconds} s deal x{damage} damage.

inferno_ring.name: Inferno Ring
inferno_ring.desc: A ring of fire {radius} m round you for {seconds} s sets enemies inside alight for x{burn} gun damage a second.

storm_call.name: Storm Call
storm_call.desc: For {seconds} s lightning strikes an enemy within {radius} m of you every {every} s for x{damage} gun damage.

spinning_blades.name: Spinning Blades
spinning_blades.desc: {blades} blades circle you for {seconds} s, cutting enemies they touch for x{damage} gun damage.

full_clip.name: Full Clip
full_clip.desc: Every ready gun is reloaded at once, and for {seconds} s you deal +{damage}% damage.

ice_lance.name: Ice Lance
ice_lance.desc: A lance flies {length} m through every enemy on its line for x{damage} gun damage and freezes them {freeze} s.

war_banner.name: War Banner
war_banner.desc: Plant a banner for {seconds} s: within {radius} m of it you deal +{damage}% damage and take {guard}% less.

harpoon_yank.name: Harpoon Yank
harpoon_yank.desc: Harpoon the enemy you aim at (up to {range} m), drag it to you and stun it {stun} s; x{damage} gun damage.

overshield.name: Overshield
overshield.desc: A shield of {shield}% of your max health soaks damage for {seconds} s.
